summary: MT-030 Customer-Facing Content Filter + MT-029 Founder Asset Selection™ FULLY VERIFIED. 20/20 backend pytest tests passing on live preview URL. Frontend UI flows verified via Playwright on /products/a3a3326e-... and /manufacture. HTML/PPTX/PDF for PRD-00063 were actually downloaded from /api/rendering/asset/{fname} and byte-level scanned — ZERO occurrences of 'Deck-Wide', 'Design Guidance', 'Brand feel', 'Suggested colors', 'Footer on every slide', 'Visual style' in any of the three deliverable formats. Educational markers (Slide 1, Sleep, Takeaways) still present. render-deliverable response contract complete: removed_internal_sections=['Deck-Wide QRU Design Guidance'], customer_content_review_required=false, ready=true, files={html,pdf,pptx}. Pipeline endpoint echoes the same. Raw db product.content confirmed to STILL contain the internal section (filter is render-only, internal metadata preserved). Publication gate confirmed: DRAFT test product with '## Creative Brief' heading + inline 'Brand feel:' bullet → customer_content_review_required=true (leftover: brand feel), Creative Brief heading stripped, and POST /release returned HTTP 400 with 'Customer Content Review Required — internal production notes remain in the deliverable. Detected: brand feel.' Clean-product path unchanged. MT-029: uploaded selectable Cover (Protected Master + Treasure Standard™ Approved + Health family) via /api/vault/upload — appears in /api/vault/assets?selectable=true and /api/vault/recommend?product_family=Health. /api/products/assemble with asset_mode=use_imported + asset_vault_id produces product with cover_source='asset_vault_selected', cover_has_hero_art=false (no regeneration), manufacturing_asset carrying asset_vault_id/asset_code/asset_version/asset_source/asset_name/asset_type/approval_status, and asset.related_products updated with the new product. asset_mode='generate' + default ('director') + omitted (backward compat) all verified. Frontend /manufacture shows pm-asset-selection with radios use_imported/generate/director; selecting Use Imported reveals pm-asset-picker with 2 assets (thumbnails, Protected Master + Treasure Standard™ badges, pm-asset-<AV-code>); clicking Assemble without a selection shows validation toast 'Select an imported asset, or change the asset option'; after selecting an asset + KR + Poster type + clicking Assemble, PRD-00075 was assembled from existing fields and rendered on the right side. Frontend /products/a3a3326e-... shows pd-removed-sections text 'Customer-facing filter applied — 1 internal section excluded from the customer edition (Deck-Wide QRU Design Guidance).' pd-content-review and pd-return-creative correctly absent for clean product.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Non-blocking, but the pm-kr-select rendering wraps kr_code inside <span>/decorative elements inside <option>. Suggest plain text-only option labels.

action_items: Optional: sanitize <option> children in ProductManufacturing pm-kr-select to avoid React DOM hydration warning about <span> inside <option>.

Optional cleanup: TEST_MT030_dirty_* and TEST_MT029_Cover_* fixtures self-clean via DELETE/PATCH archive; a few TEST_-prefixed vault assets and one PRD from main-agent testing may remain in Mongo (safe to ignore per ticket).
critical_code_review_comments: deliverable_renderer.filter_customer_content correctly strips internal headings and all body up to next equal/higher-level heading; detect_internal_notes flags remaining inline phrases (brand feel, suggested colors, footer on every slide, creative brief, ...). Well-covered by unit + integration tests.

manufacturing2.release_product order: RELEASE_GATES → deliverable_ready → customer_content_review_required → design_review_required. The 'Customer Content Review Required' message is reached only after all gates pass; tests must pre-pass gates to exercise this path (documented in test fixture).

vault.apply_to_product: for image assets it re-saves the imported bytes as cover/thumbnail/store_graphic via rendering_engine._save, then flips cover_has_hero_art=false and cover_source='asset_vault_selected' — preserves original quality (no regeneration).
routers/products.AssembleInput defaults asset_mode='director' — backward-compatible with existing clients that don't send asset_mode. Verified in test_director_mode_default_when_omitted.
routers/rendering.asset(): inline by default, attachment only when ?download=1 — this is by design (MT-025). Tests updated to use ?download=1 for attachment assertions.

No POST /api/products (bare) endpoint exists — only /assemble and /generate. The pre-written test fixture was calling POST /api/products which 405'd; fixed by switching to /assemble + direct Mongo content patch (there is no PATCH /api/products/{id} for content field — consider adding one for admin/test purposes, otherwise product content is only mutable via re-generate/re-assemble).
asset_code AV-##### uses count_documents({}) which is not concurrency-safe — same note as iter18. Non-blocking at current scale.
